operation.summary: Render an email without sending it: the subject, the styled HTML (Bridgit's card design by default) and the plain-text alternative. Nothing leaves the phone

body.name: markdown
body.description: Markdown body: headings, bold, italic, links, lists, code (up to 100 KB)

body.name: html
body.description: Your own HTML body (up to 100 KB); scripts, iframes, forms, event handlers, remote styles and javascript: links are removed

body.name: style
body.description: card (default): framed in the Bridgit card; plain: your body without the frame

body.name: to
body.description: Optional recipients to check (1-20 addresses); nothing is sent to them

operation.example: POST /v1/email/preview {"subject": "Front door", "markdown": "**Someone** is at the door."}
operation.returns: subject, style, html, text, html_bytes, to[] (when given, cleaned and de-duplicated), sent: false

markdown.description: Markdown body: headings, bold, italic, links, lists, code (up to 100 KB)

html.description: Your own HTML body (up to 100 KB); scripts, iframes, forms, event handlers, remote styles and javascript: links are removed

style.description: card (default): framed in the Bridgit card; plain: your body without the frame

to.description: Optional recipients to check (1-20 addresses); nothing is sent to them
